name: The Syndicate Sting
summary: In Stromgarde, you get word of a secret Syndicate handoff near Thoradin’s Wall. The object being traded remains unknown, and Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor wants it.

sections.title: A Secret Handoff
sections.body: Falconcrest arranged the handoff. Some of his men are meeting at the southern part of Thoradin’s Wall, though even those sent to collect the goods may not know what they are taking. You are asked to break up the deal and bring the traded object back to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

faq.q: Who sent men to the handoff?
faq.answer: Falconcrest sent men to make the handoff at the southern part of Thoradin’s Wall.
The handoff is set for the southern part of Thoradin’s Wall.
The object being traded is unknown, and even the men sent to collect it may not know what it is.
Myrokos Silentform asks you to break up the deal, take the object being traded to the Syndicate, and return it to him at Ravenholdt Manor.
